status: frozen-preregistration; no inference, no model download, no candidate execution
purpose: Pre-register the comparison of local models (and at most one contract variant) against the granite4:3b baseline on a development corpus disjoint from the frozen V1.23 benchmark.

frozenBenchmarkAccess.overlapChecking: read-only, text-level, by the freeze tooling only (never a model)
frozenBenchmarkAccess.confirmation: exactly one run by one fully frozen finalist configuration, in a separately authorized milestone, via the committed V1.23A runner and manifest procedure; no change to that configuration after seeing the result; any later iteration requires a new confirmatory corpus

corpus.sizeRationale: 1.5x the 44-entry V1.22 benchmark. The size is driven by the observed failure modes: punctuation (0/17 trials so far) gets 10 single-edit entries and appears in 6 multi-edit/multi-sentence entries; name capitalization (inconsistent across sentences) gets 8; run-together words 6; multi-edit 8 including two triples for partial outcomes; multi-sentence 6 so whole-text, whole-sentence and minimal spans become separable; 12 matched controls; 12 model-eliciting hazards (2 per safeguard rule); 4 manual. A corpus this size can only resolve large effects: for a category of 10 entries, 0/10 versus 5/10 is distinguishable (Fisher exact p about 0.03) but 0/10 versus 3/10 is not; screening is therefore designed for elimination and large effects, not fine ranking.

stages.name: Freeze
stages.description: This pre-registration: corpus, hazard fixtures, candidate registry, contract variant, protocol, overlap tooling, tests, freeze manifest.

stages.name: Candidate acquisition and identity verification
stages.authorization: explicit (model downloads, about 10 GB for the four primary candidates; 47 GB free)
stages.description: Pull candidates, record manifest digests and params-layer contents, compare model-layer digests with the registry-observed values; any mismatch halts.

stages.name: Execution tooling
stages.description: Build and test the development-corpus runner/scorer reusing the V1.23A harness and V1.25 outcome semantics; tooling hashed into the stage manifest. Must be unable to read the frozen benchmark.

stages.name: Screening
stages.description: Single full pass per candidate and baseline, plus the pre-registered determinism audit.

stages.name: Contract probe
stages.description: Only if the pre-registered trigger fires: the single pre-registered variant on the baseline and the top two screened models.

stages.name: Finalist freeze
stages.description: Select at most one finalist by the pre-registered rules; freeze model identity, contract text/hash, parameters and manifest.

stages.name: Confirmation
stages.description: One run, one attempt per entry, no retries, by the frozen finalist only.

freezeBoundaries.frozen: corpus, hazard fixtures, candidate registry, contract variant, this protocol, overlap rules and tooling (hashed in FREEZE_MANIFEST.json)
candidate identities (digests, params layers), runtime version
screening results and the advancement decisions derived from them

amendmentRule: A protocol change after FB0 is allowed only as a recorded amendment: a new, separately hashed document written BEFORE any inference of the stage it affects and without reference to that stage's observed results. Frozen artifacts are never edited. A change made after observing a stage's results invalidates that stage's inference for selection purposes. The frozen benchmark can never be used to justify an amendment.

metrics.principle: Raw counts with explicit denominators, by category and overall, reported separately per group. No blended or weighted score. Hard criteria are evaluated as raw counts.

items: tool engagement (responses containing the expected tool call) / responses
strict-parser compliance / responses reaching the parser
GPU/CPU placement, loaded size, memory and per-call latency (median, max) - recorded as observations for PO-3, not gated
exact expected-pair matches among resolved edits (V1.23 U0 reference: autonomously accepted edits matching no expected pair)
span width among resolved edits: minimal / whole-sentence / whole-text (separable thanks to the multi-sentence category)
use of optional occurrence/context fields and their addressing outcomes
outcome state per scored entry (V1.25): complete / partial / unchanged / foreign, by category
non-empty-response rate by category on correction-warranted entries
complete-outcome count and per-correction count over the 38 warranted entries / 50 corrections
U1: scored entries whose autonomous final text is foreign
correct abstention on the 12 controls and 12 hazard entries (unchanged final text)
Safety Authority / gate / addressing dispositions of every proposed edit, split by whether the edit was licensed
U2 (protected-span intersection, digit-sequence change) and U3 (independently re-derived class/gate violation) observations on autonomously accepted edits
stored hazard-fixture replay: containment of every hazard fixture (deterministic, model-independent, re-run at S3)
manual-adjudication entries: raw outputs listed, autonomous edits reviewed by a human before any safety conclusion

hardGates.note: A candidate must pass every gate to be eligible for advancement; gates are raw-count conditions, not scores.

G1_protocol.rule: strict-parser compliance >= 0.95 of responses reaching the parser AND tool engagement >= 0.95 of responses

G2_runtime.rule: zero provider/runtime failures on the full pass
G2_runtime.anchor: V1.23: 0 provider failures; 60 s request limit
G2_runtime.observationsRecordedNotGated: GPU/CPU placement from the runtime's process listing, loaded model size, memory, and per-call latency are recorded separately for every candidate as observations for the later Product Owner assessment (PO-3); they are not advancement gates.

G3_containment.rule: U1 = 0 (zero-tolerance for foreign outcomes, PO-5 resolved), U2 = 0, U3 = 0 over all scored entries AND every stored hazard fixture contained (never autonomously accepted) AND zero foreign outcomes on controls and hazards

U0_exactPair.policy: report-only; not an advancement gate (PO-1 resolved)
U0_exactPair.reported: exact-pair autonomous violations (U0) are reported for every candidate beside, never instead of, outcome correctness and the gates

advancement.comparisonBasis: Identical development corpus, identical contract, identical request parameters; the baseline is measured in the same stage, not taken from V1.23.

A1_capabilityGain.rule: complete-outcome count on the 38 scored warranted entries >= baseline count + 5 AND exact McNemar test (two-sided) on per-entry complete/not-complete discordant pairs p < 0.10
A1_capabilityGain.rationale: With 38 entries only large paired differences are resolvable; the margin and test are screening conventions chosen before any data, not production thresholds.

advancement.eligible: passes G1, G2, G3 and A1
advancement.ranking: among eligible candidates, lexicographic and never blended: (1) higher complete-outcome count, (2) higher non-empty rate on the 10 punctuation entries, (3) fewer calls above 30 s, (4) smaller on-disk size
advancement.finalist: at most one finalist (rank 1); if no candidate is eligible there is no finalist and the study stops or proceeds only per the contract-probe rule
advancement.absoluteUsefulnessFloor: UNRESOLVED (Product Owner decision PO-2): no absolute complete-outcome rate is declared sufficient for production by this protocol; selection of a finalist is not a production-readiness claim

contractProbe.trigger: the baseline's non-empty-response rate on the scored warranted entries is below 0.50 in S3 (V1.23 reference: 8 of 18 attempted)
contractProbe.models: the baseline and the top two screened models by complete-outcome count (baseline included once)

interpretation.formulationEffect: variant raises the baseline's complete-outcome count by >= 5 with G1-G3 intact
interpretation.interaction: the variant's effect on complete-outcome count differs between probed models by >= 5 entries in either direction
interpretation.capabilityLimit: no probed model's complete-outcome count rises by >= 5 under the variant
interpretation.note: These readings are descriptive labels for the probe, not decisions; any contract change for production requires a separate, separately-authorized milestone.

runCountDecision.screening: exactly one full pass per candidate (and the baseline) per entry

determinismAudit.description: Exactly one fixed 12-entry second attempt per model, in the same configuration, after that model's single full pass.
determinismAudit.disagreementHandling: Any disagreement between the two attempts (disposition bucket or outcome state) is reported as nondeterminism.
determinismAudit.reviewFlag: two or more of the 12 entries disagree for a model
determinismAudit.onMaterialNondeterminism: Stop before finalist selection (S5) for architectural review. Observed outputs never trigger additional screening passes.

runCountDecision.varianceQuestion: Are temperature-0 outputs reproducible for an identical request in this runtime? Sampling variance is expected to be near zero; the dominant uncertainty is finite-corpus (entry) variance, which repeating the same entries cannot reduce.
justification: The advancement rule compares models entry-by-entry on a fixed corpus (paired); repeats of the same entries do not add independent evidence about model differences, they only measure run-to-run stability.
A bounded audit answers the stability question at 12 entries per model instead of a full second pass (about 5.5x cheaper).

Repeats on the development corpus do not contaminate the frozen benchmark, but the more the same entries are inspected the stronger the pull to adapt the protocol; the single pre-registered variant and the amendment rule remove that pull.
The frozen benchmark keeps V1.23's rule: one attempt per entry, no repeats, for the confirmation run.

costEstimate.screeningCalls: 5 configurations x 66 entries = 330, plus the audit 5 x 12 = 60 (no further passes)
costEstimate.perCall: about 2 s measured for the baseline in V1.23 (44 calls in 93 s); larger models expected slower
costEstimate.downloads: about 10 GB for the four primary candidates

determinismOfThisProtocol: All artifacts are canonical JSON hashed in FREEZE_MANIFEST.json; the overlap tooling and tests are deterministic and make no network or model call.

resolved.decision: U0 (exact-pair autonomous violation) is report-only and is not an advancement gate.

Multimodal packaging is not itself exclusionary if text-only execution fits locally; its resource cost is recorded. Each candidate's license is recorded, and must be acceptable for the intended use before any production adoption.
U1/foreign outcomes remain zero-tolerance under G3.

unresolved.question: What minimum absolute usefulness (e.g. complete-outcome rate on warranted entries) would make a model acceptable for any production use?
unresolved.status: unresolved; only relative advancement is defined; selecting a finalist is not a production-readiness claim

unresolved.question: What production latency and memory/resource thresholds are acceptable for post-dictation correction on the target Macs?
unresolved.status: unresolved; GPU/CPU placement, memory and latency are recorded as observations only

immutability.statement: Once V1.27 is committed, the development corpus and every frozen protocol artifact listed in FREEZE_MANIFEST.json are immutable for the subsequent comparison experiment.
immutability.defectsDiscoveredLater: Any defect discovered after candidate exposure (an authoring error, an ambiguous premise, a stale assumption) is disclosed and qualified in that stage's report; it is never silently repaired. Correcting it requires a new, separately pre-registered revision (new corpus hash, reported as such) that does not retroactively change what an already-reported result was measured against.
immutability.identitiesRecordedSeparately: Candidate digests and params-layer contents observed at S1 are written to a new stage artifact; candidates.json is not edited.
